topic: Remission maintenance in AAV: azathioprine, rituximab, MAINRITSAN trial

source.title: Rituximab versus azathioprine for maintenance of remission for patients with ANCA-associated vasculitis and relapsing disease: an international randomised controlled trial
source.whyItFits: Open trial paper that states the MAINRITSAN 1 result—rituximab superior to azathioprine after cyclophosphamide induction in newly diagnosed AAV—and distinguishes that population from later relapse trials.

whyItFits: Open trial paper that states the MAINRITSAN 1 result—rituximab superior to azathioprine after cyclophosphamide induction in newly diagnosed AAV—and distinguishes that population from later relapse trials.
coverageNote: The MAINRITSAN trial report itself was not open. This paper is accepted only for the MAINRITSAN results it explicitly states. RITAZAREM efficacy numbers are not presented as MAINRITSAN results.
rejectedInAppHints: A calprotectin post-hoc of MAINRITSAN was rejected as not the maintenance comparison. An airway-remission consensus was off-topic.
